title: My first AI assisted game: Stunt Track Racer VR
author: TeslaDriver_
selftext:
Hi there!

This game was made in a dialog with Claude Code Opus 5.5. Up to its first release it took 6 days. 

Inspired by Stunt Car Racer (1989) by Geoff Crammond!

replies.author: TeslaDriver_
replies.body:
At the very first I instructed at Claude Code Opus 5.5:

Write a game in the visual style of the classic C64 / Amiga title "Stunt Car Racer", but this time in VR (OpenXR) on this machine.

* Please research how the original game worked first.
* For controls, a Thrustmaster steering wheel with throttle and brake pedals is available and should be integrated directly via USB.
* The forward-facing cockpit view should be weighted 50% toward the world horizon/vertical and 50% toward the vehicle's tilt/pitch.
* The headset's 6DOF tracking should then apply relative to this blended baseline orientation.
* Pressing the F12 key should recenter VR.
